            <div class="guide-box">
                <h2 class="section-title" style="font-size: 1.8rem; margin-bottom: 20px;">How to Choose the Right TV Wall Unit for Your Living Room</h2>
                <p style="color: var(--text-gray); margin-bottom: 24px;">Picking a TV wall unit isn't just about matching your sofa—it's about the room's layout, your storage needs, and how the space is used day to day. A few things worth thinking through before you order a custom TV unit in UAE:</p>
                
                <div class="guide-item">
                    <h3>Measure your wall and viewing distance first</h3>
                    <p>The width of your TV wall unit should generally be close to the width of your TV console area, and the screen's center should sit at eye level when seated. For most Dubai living rooms, this means a floating or low-profile unit works better than a tall cabinet, which can crowd the sightline.</p>
                </div>
                
                <div class="guide-item">
                    <h3>Decide how much storage you actually need</h3>
                    <p>If you store gaming consoles, routers, décor, or books in the living room, a storage-rich TV cabinet with concealed compartments keeps cables and clutter out of sight. If the room is minimal by design, a slim floating TV mount with little to no cabinetry often looks cleaner.</p>
                </div>
                
                <div class="guide-item">
                    <h3>Match the finish to the rest of the room</h3>
                    <p>A wooden TV unit warms up a room with cooler tones (marble floors, grey walls), while a marble-finish TV unit pairs well with warmer wood flooring or a more traditional interior. Mixing one accent material (like a marble strip or wood-slat panel) is usually enough - using both throughout tends to compete rather than complement.</p>
                </div>
                
                <div class="guide-item">
                    <h3>Think about lighting early, not as an afterthought</h3>
                    <p>Integrated LED lighting is far easier and neater to plan into a custom TV unit at the design stage than to retrofit later. If you want a warm, ambient look in the evening, mention it when you're discussing the design—it changes where cables and drivers need to be routed inside the unit.</p>
                </div>
                
                <div class="guide-item">
                    <h3>Don't skip cable and ventilation planning</h3>
                    <p>Behind almost every TV wall unit issue we get called out to fix later is poor cable routing or a lack of ventilation behind enclosed electronics. A well-designed custom TV unit builds in cable channels and vents from the start, so your setup stays tidy and your equipment doesn't overheat.</p>
                </div>
            </div>

    <script>
        document.querySelectorAll('.faq-question').forEach(item => {
            item.addEventListener('click', () => {
                const parent = item.parentElement;
                const isActive = parent.classList.contains('active');
                
                document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
                
                if (!isActive) {
                    parent.classList.add('active');
                }
            });
        });

        document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
            anchor.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                const target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href'));
                if(target) {
                    target.scrollIntoView({
                        behavior: 'smooth',
                        block: 'start'
                    });
                }
            });
        });
    </script>

    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/bootstrap/5.3.0/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
    <script>
        function openFullView(pdfUrl, title) {
            const modal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('pdfModal'));
            
            let finalUrl = pdfUrl + '#view=FitH';
            if (window.innerWidth < 992) {
                finalUrl = 'https://docs.google.com/viewer?url=https://theyyampattilgcc.com/' + pdfUrl + '&embedded=true';
            }

            document.getElementById('modalIframe').src = finalUrl;
            document.getElementById('modalTitle').innerText = title;
            document.getElementById('modalDownloadBtn').href = pdfUrl;
            modal.show();
        }
        
        document.getElementById('pdfModal').addEventListener('hidden.bs.modal', function () {
            document.getElementById('modalIframe').src = '';
        });
    </script>

    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/glightbox/dist/js/glightbox.min.js"></script>
    <script>
        // Lightbox Initializer
        const lightbox = GLightbox({
            selector: '.glightbox',
            touchNavigation: true,
            loop: true,
            zoomable: true,
            draggable: true
        });

        // Clickable FAQ Accordion Interactivity
        document.querySelectorAll('.faq-question').forEach(button => {
            button.addEventListener('click', () => {
                const faqItem = button.parentElement;
                const isOpen = faqItem.classList.contains('active');

                // Close all FAQ items
                document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(item => {
                    item.classList.remove('active');
                    item.querySelector('.faq-question').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
                });

                // Open clicked item if it was closed
                if (!isOpen) {
                    faqItem.classList.add('active');
                    button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
                }
            });
        });
    </script>

<script>
    // FAQ Accordion Toggle JS
    document.querySelectorAll('.faq-question').forEach(button => {
        button.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const faqItem = button.parentElement;
            const isOpen = faqItem.classList.contains('active');
            
            // Close all items
            document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(item => {
                item.classList.remove('active');
                item.querySelector('.faq-question').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
            });

            // Open clicked item if it was not open
            if (!isOpen) {
                faqItem.classList.add('active');
                button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
            }
        });
    });
</script>

    <!-- FAQ CLICK TOGGLE INTERACTION SCRIPT -->
    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const faqItems = document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item');

            faqItems.forEach(item => {
                const questionBtn = item.querySelector('.faq-question');
                
                questionBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const isActive = item.classList.contains('active');

                    // Close all FAQs
                    faqItems.forEach(faq => {
                        faq.classList.remove('active');
                        faq.querySelector('.faq-question').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
                    });

                    // Toggle clicked FAQ
                    if (!isActive) {
                        item.classList.add('active');
                        questionBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
                    }
                });
            });
        });
    </script>

  <!-- Deferred, minimal JS — no layout/paint blocking -->
  <script>
    (function(){
      var h=document.getElementById('site-header'),
          t=document.getElementById('navToggle'),
          m=document.getElementById('mobileNav'),
          ticking=false;

      /* Scroll: throttled via rAF */
      function onScroll(){
        if(!ticking){
          requestAnimationFrame(function(){
            h.classList.toggle('scrolled',window.scrollY>60);
            ticking=false;
          });
          ticking=true;
        }
      }
      window.addEventListener('scroll',onScroll,{passive:true});

      /* Hamburger toggle */
      t.addEventListener('click',function(){
        var open=m.classList.toggle('open');
        t.classList.toggle('active',open);
        t.setAttribute('aria-expanded',open);
        document.body.style.overflow=open?'hidden':'';
      });

      /* Close mobile nav on link click */
      m.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(function(a){
        a.addEventListener('click',function(){
          m.classList.remove('open');
          t.classList.remove('active');
          t.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
          document.body.style.overflow='';
        });
      });

      /* Close on resize to desktop */
      window.addEventListener('resize',function(){
        if(window.innerWidth>1024&&m.classList.contains('open')){
          m.classList.remove('open');
          t.classList.remove('active');
          t.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
          document.body.style.overflow='';
        }
      },{passive:true});
    })();
  </script>
</header>

  <script>
    /* Minimal, non-blocking inline script — no external deps */
    (function(){
      var h=document.getElementById('site-header');
      var t=document.getElementById('navToggle');
      var m=document.getElementById('mobileNav');
      var ticking=false;

      function onScroll(){
        if(!ticking){
          requestAnimationFrame(function(){
            h.classList.toggle('scrolled',window.scrollY>60);
            ticking=false;
          });
          ticking=true;
        }
      }
      window.addEventListener('scroll',onScroll,{passive:true});

      t.addEventListener('click',function(){
        var open=m.classList.toggle('open');
        t.classList.toggle('active',open);
        t.setAttribute('aria-expanded',open);
        document.body.style.overflow=open?'hidden':'';
      });

      m.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(function(a){
        a.addEventListener('click',function(){
          m.classList.remove('open');
          t.classList.remove('active');
          t.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
          document.body.style.overflow='';
        });
      });

      window.addEventListener('resize',function(){
        if(window.innerWidth>1024&&m.classList.contains('open')){
          m.classList.remove('open');
          t.classList.remove('active');
          t.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
          document.body.style.overflow='';
        }
      },{passive:true});
    })();
  </script>

        let globalSlideIndex = 0;

        function startMasterSyncSlide() {
            setInterval(() => {
                globalSlideIndex++;
                const wrappers = document.querySelectorAll('.sync-wrapper');
                
                wrappers.forEach((wrapper, i) => {
                    const p = products[i];
                    if (!p || p.imgs.length <= 1) return;

                    const totalImgs = p.imgs.length;
                    const localIndex = globalSlideIndex % totalImgs;
                    
                    const movePercentage = localIndex * (100 / totalImgs);
                    wrapper.style.transform = `translateX(-${movePercentage}%)`;
                    
                    const container = wrapper.closest('.img-container');
                    const dots = container.querySelectorAll('.dot');
                    dots.forEach((d, idx) => {
                        if(idx === localIndex) {
                            d.classList.add('bg-[#c5a367]', 'scale-125');
                            d.classList.remove('bg-white/30');
                        } else {
                            d.classList.remove('bg-[#c5a367]', 'scale-125');
                            d.classList.add('bg-white/30');
                        }
                    });
                });
            }, 3500);
        }

        function openProductLightbox(productIndex) {
            const lb = document.getElementById('lightbox');
            const product = products[productIndex];
            const displayImages = (product.gallery && product.gallery.length > 0) ? product.gallery : product.imgs;

            lb.innerHTML = `
                <div class="relative w-full h-full flex flex-col items-center max-w-5xl mx-auto">
                    <div class="w-full flex justify-between items-center py-4 border-b border-white/10 mb-6">
                        <div>
                            <h4 class="text-white font-bold text-lg">${product.name}</h4>
                            <p class="text-[#c5a367] text-xs">${product.tag}</p>
                        </div>
                        <button onclick="closeLightbox()" class="bg-white text-black px-6 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold uppercase text-xs shadow-2xl hover:bg-[#c5a367] transition-all">
                            ✕ Close Inventory
                        </button>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex flex-col gap-6 overflow-y-auto w-full items-center pb-24 custom-scrollbar">
                        ${displayImages.map(img => `
                            <div class="w-full bg-[#1e1e1e] p-2 rounded-2xl border border-white/5">
                                <img src="${img}" class="w-full h-auto max-h-[80vh] object-contain rounded-xl" loading="lazy" alt="Furniture Inventory Detail Item" onerror="this.src='https://via.placeholder.com/800x1000?text=Image+Not+Found'">
                            </div>
                        `).join('')}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
            
            lb.classList.remove('hidden');
            lb.style.display = 'flex';
            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        }

        function closeLightbox() {
            const lb = document.getElementById('lightbox');
            lb.style.display = 'none';
            lb.classList.add('hidden');
            lb.innerHTML = '';
            document.body.style.overflow = '';
        }

        document.getElementById('lightbox').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            if (e.target === this) closeLightbox();
        });

        function renderGrid() {
            const grid = document.getElementById('product-grid-sync');
            if(!grid) return;
            
            grid.innerHTML = products.map((p, i) => {
                const imgCount = p.imgs.length;
                return `
                <div class="bg-[#1e1e1e] rounded-2xl border border-white/5 overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-between group hover:border-[#c5a367]/40 transition-all duration-300 shadow-xl">
                    <div class="img-container group relative cursor-pointer" onclick="openProductLightbox(${i})">
                        
                        <div class="absolute top-3 left-3 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md text-white font-extrabold text-[10px] tracking-widest uppercase px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md border border-white/10 z-30">
                            CUSTOMIZED FURNITURE ITEM
                        </div>

                        <div class="slider-wrapper sync-wrapper flex h-full transition-transform duration-1000 ease-in-out" style="width: ${imgCount * 100}%">
                            ${p.imgs.map(src => `
                                <div style="width: ${100 / imgCount}%" class="h-full overflow-hidden">
                                    <img src="${src}" width="400" height="500" class="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-700 group-hover:scale-105" loading="lazy" alt="${p.name} Production Line Model Asset">
                                </div>
                            `).join('')}
                        </div>
                        
                        <div class="absolute bottom-4 right-4 flex gap-1.5 z-20 bg-black/40 px-2 py-1 rounded-full backdrop-blur-sm">
                            ${p.imgs.map((_, idx) => `
                                <div class="dot w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-white/30 transition-all duration-300 ${idx === 0 ? 'bg-[#c5a367] scale-125' : ''}"></div>
                            `).join('')}
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="p-5 flex-grow flex flex-col justify-between">
                        <div class="mb-4">
                            <span class="text-xs text-[#c5a367] uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold block mb-1">${p.tag}</span>
                            <h3 class="text-white font-bold text-lg leading-tight tracking-tight">${p.name}</h3>
                            <div class="mt-2 text-xs text-gray-400 font-medium flex items-center gap-1">
                                <span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 inline-block"></span> Standard Customization Available
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        
                        <div class="pt-4 border-t border-white/5 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">

                                📝ENQUIRE

                                📞Call Store
                            </a>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                `;
            }).join('');
        }

    <script>
    window.addEventListener('load', () => {
        const phoneInput = document.querySelector("#phone");
        const countryHidden = document.querySelector("#country_code");
        const form = document.querySelector("#furniture-form");
        const submitBtn = document.querySelector("#submit-btn");
        const responseMsg = document.querySelector("#form-response-msg");
        
        let iti = null;
        if (window.intlTelInput && phoneInput) {
            iti = window.intlTelInput(phoneInput, {
                initialCountry: "auto",
                geoIpLookup: function(success, failure) {
                    fetch('https://ipinfo.io/json').then(res => res.json()).then(data => {
                        success(data.country);
                        if (countryHidden) countryHidden.value = data.country.toUpperCase();
                    }).catch(() => {
                        success("ae");
                        if (countryHidden) countryHidden.value = "AE";
                    });
                },
                utilsScript: "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/intl-tel-input/17.0.8/js/utils.js",
            });
        }

        if(form) {
            form.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                
                if (iti && phoneInput) {
                    phoneInput.value = iti.getNumber(); 
                }

                if (submitBtn) {
                    submitBtn.disabled = true;
                    submitBtn.innerHTML = 'Sending...';
                }

                if (responseMsg) {
                    responseMsg.classList.add('hidden');
                    responseMsg.innerText = '';
                }

                const formData = new FormData(form);

                fetch(form.getAttribute('action'), {
                    method: 'POST',
                    body: formData
                })
                .then(res => {
                    if (res.redirected) {
                        window.location.href = res.url;
                        return null; // FIXED: Kill the promise chain if we are redirecting
                    }
                    return res.text();
                })
                .then(data => {
                    if (data === null) return; // FIXED: Prevent `undefined` error if redirected

                    if (submitBtn) {
                        submitBtn.disabled = false;
                        submitBtn.innerHTML = 'Submit Request';
                    }
                    if (responseMsg) {
                        responseMsg.classList.remove('hidden');
                        if (data && data.toLowerCase().includes('success')) {
                            responseMsg.className = 'text-xs text-center font-bold mt-2 text-emerald-400';
                            responseMsg.innerText = 'Thank you! Your request has been sent successfully.';
                            form.reset();
                        } else {
                            // FIXED: Added absolute path to prevent recursive folder stacking
                            window.location.href = '/store/thank-you.php';
                        }
                    }
                })
                .catch(err => {
                    if (submitBtn) {
                        submitBtn.disabled = false;
                        submitBtn.innerHTML = 'Submit Request';
                    }
                    if (responseMsg) {
                        responseMsg.classList.remove('hidden');
                        responseMsg.className = 'text-xs text-center font-bold mt-2 text-rose-400';
                        responseMsg.innerText = 'Network error. Please try again.';
                    }
                });
            });
        }

        if (window.gsap && window.ScrollTrigger) {
            gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);
            gsap.from(".bg-[#1e1e1e]", {
                scrollTrigger: { trigger: "#products", start: "top 85%" },
                y: 30,
                opacity: 0,
                duration: 0.8,
                stagger: 0.08,
                ease: "power2.out"
            });
        }
    });
    </script>
</body>

    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            // FAQ Accordion Interaction
            const faqQuestions = document.querySelectorAll('.faq-question');
            faqQuestions.forEach(question => {
                question.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const faqItem = question.parentElement;
                    const isExpanded = question.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
                    
                    // Close all other FAQ items
                    document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(item => {
                        if (item !== faqItem) {
                            item.classList.remove('active');
                            item.querySelector('.faq-question').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
                        }
                    });

                    // Toggle current item
                    faqItem.classList.toggle('active');
                    question.setAttribute('aria-expanded', !isExpanded);
                });
            });

            // Smooth Delay for AOS Animations
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (typeof AOS !== 'undefined') {
                    AOS.init({
                        duration: 700,
                        once: true,
                        offset: 40,
                        disable: 'mobile'
                    });
                }
            }, 100);
        });
    </script>

  <script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      const slides = document.querySelectorAll('.hero-slide');
      const dots = document.querySelectorAll('.hero-dot');
      let current = 0;
      let timer;

      function goToSlide(n){
        slides[current].classList.remove('active');
        dots[current].classList.remove('active');
        current = (n + slides.length) % slides.length;
        slides[current].classList.add('active');
        dots[current].classList.add('active');
        resetTimer();
      }

      function resetTimer() {
        clearInterval(timer);
        timer = setInterval(() => {
          requestAnimationFrame(() => goToSlide(current + 1));
        }, 6000);
      }

      window.addEventListener('load', () => {
        const otherImages = [
          'assets/images/home-page/hero-banner/hero-slider-2.avif'
        ];
        otherImages.forEach(src => {
          const img = new Image();
          img.src = src;
        });
      }, {passive: true});

      window.goToSlide = goToSlide;
      resetTimer();
    });
  </script>

  <script>
    function toggleFaq(btn) {
      const isExpanded = btn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
      const allBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.faq-q');
      
      allBtns.forEach(otherBtn => {
        if (otherBtn !== btn && otherBtn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true') {
          otherBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
          otherBtn.nextElementSibling.style.maxHeight = '0';
        }
      });

      const content = btn.nextElementSibling;
      if (!isExpanded) {
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        content.style.maxHeight = content.scrollHeight + "px";
      } else {
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        content.style.maxHeight = '0';
      }
    }
  </script>

  <script>
    function initTestimonialSlider() {
      const track = document.getElementById('testimonialsTrack');
      const prevBtn = document.getElementById('tstPrev');
      const nextBtn = document.getElementById('tstNext');
      const dotsContainer = document.getElementById('tstDots');
      const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.testimonial-card');
      let currentIndex = 0;

      function getVisibleCards() {
        if (window.innerWidth <= 600) return 1;
        if (window.innerWidth <= 900) return 2;
        return 3;
      }

      function updateSlider() {
        const visibleCards = getVisibleCards();
        const maxIndex = Math.max(0, cards.length - visibleCards);
        if (currentIndex > maxIndex) currentIndex = maxIndex;

        const cardWidth = cards[0].getBoundingClientRect().width;
        const gap = 20;
        const moveAmount = (cardWidth + gap) * currentIndex;
        
        track.style.transform = `translate3d(-${moveAmount}px, 0, 0)`;

        dotsContainer.innerHTML = '';
        const totalDots = maxIndex + 1;
        for (let i = 0; i < totalDots; i++) {
          const dot = document.createElement('button');
          dot.className = `tst-dot ${i === currentIndex ? 'active' : ''}`;
          dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
          dot.addEventListener('click', () => {
            currentIndex = i;
            updateSlider();
          });
          dotsContainer.appendChild(dot);
        }
      }

      prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (currentIndex > 0) {
          currentIndex--;
        } else {
          currentIndex = Math.max(0, cards.length - getVisibleCards());
        }
        updateSlider();
      });

      nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const maxIndex = Math.max(0, cards.length - getVisibleCards());
        if (currentIndex < maxIndex) {
          currentIndex++;
        } else {
          currentIndex = 0;
        }
        updateSlider();
      });

      window.addEventListener('resize', updateSlider, { passive: true });
      updateSlider();
    }

    // Defer slider init until the testimonials section is actually near the viewport,
    // instead of running it eagerly during initial page load (reduces Total Blocking Time).
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      const section = document.getElementById('testimonials-section');
      if (!section) return;

      if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
        const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries, obs) => {
          entries.forEach(entry => {
            if (entry.isIntersecting) {
              initTestimonialSlider();
              obs.disconnect();
            }
          });
        }, { rootMargin: '300px 0px' });
        observer.observe(section);
      } else {
        initTestimonialSlider();
      }
    });
  </script>
</section>
<!-- testimonials section ends -->
